profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at TaskRabbit
profile.summary: I get the boosters boosting, I get computers 'puting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Automated accounting and HR workflows to increase transparency and interaction between customer and services teams
•	Integrated data from third party systems using APIs (e.g. Bill.com, Expensify, Quickbooks Enterprise) to provide customers with actionable dashboards
•	Worked closely with product management team to engineer and deliver robust applications for both internal and external use

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Wrote and consumed web service APIs using JSON and XML
•	Developed and maintained several web sites including consumer facing properties, custom CMS and reporting dashboard
•	Collaborated with content, marketing, product management, and design teams to create and present unique user experiences

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
•	Analyzed health care client’s current process and C++ code and reported findings to be used in proposal for an automated claims adjustment process
•	Produced written test cases for a first release version of an application that obfuscates test data from a production database
•	Automated user interface test cases using Selenium and Java
•	Created Linux Bash scripts to automate the extraction of data from COBOL data extracts to Oracle 10g database, SQL scripts to transform data according to specifications, and both shell and SQL scripts to automate data and integrity testing
•	Completed extensive three month Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) training class which included three projects spanning the entire project life cycle including requirements gathering, analysis and design, coding, and testing
•	Delivered artifacts across all phases of the SDLC including vision documents, business rules, use cases, data mapping documents, test cases and physical and logical models

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Created new web pages based on Photoshop mockups provided by lead designer
•	Aided in design and creation of e-commerce pages and transaction processing
•	Performed extensive QA testing on the production site, fixed and logged bugs in tracking utility

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed, created, and maintained website to promote social awareness and reduction of electronic waste
•	Developed dynamic, database-driven pages and forms
•	Used external RSS feeds to populate pages with relevant data from outside sources

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
•	Wrote C code that computed two point angular correlation function
•	Ported CPU code to Cell Broadband Engine (microprocessor used in the Sony Playstation 3)
•	Contributed to research paper and grant proposal
